title: The Moth in the Bath
lines: Nan set up a bath, and Josh got in.
Then a moth fell in with him!
Nan got a thin red mug.
She let the moth sit on it.
Then she set it on the path.
Both the moth and Josh were wet.
"That moth had a bath as well!" said Nan.

questions.ask: What does Nan use to get the moth out?
questions.listenFor: A thin red mug. It is stated in the story - have them reread that line instead of telling them.

questions.ask: Where does Nan put the moth?
questions.listenFor: On the path. Listen for the word path, not just "outside."

questions.ask: Was the moth glad to get out? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You want a reason tied to the story, like "yes, it was wet and moths do not swim."
